cleanup.about_build_caches: What developer tools download and build. Safe to clear, but the next build takes longer.
cleanup.about_caches: Copies apps keep to open things faster. They make them again when needed.
cleanup.about_installers: Setup files in Downloads, rarely needed once an app is installed.
cleanup.about_logs: Reports of past crashes, and apps' records of what they did.
cleanup.about_old_downloads: Files in Downloads untouched for three months. Look through them first.
cleanup.about_temp: Files apps left behind while working. Ones changed in the last day are left alone, as they may be in use.
cleanup.about_trash: Files you've deleted. Emptying it deletes them for good.
cleanup.and_more: And {n} more, checked and unchecked with the group
cleanup.confirm_delete: Temporary files, caches and logs are deleted for good; apps make what they need again.
cleanup.confirm_downloads_deleted: Downloads are deleted for good: this device has no trash.
cleanup.confirm_empty: The trash is emptied, so what's in it can't be put back.
cleanup.confirm_trash: Downloads go to the trash, where you can put them back.
cleanup.find_copies_of_the_same_file: Find copies of the same file, and look-alike photos
cleanup.intro: Finds files this device can do without: temporary files, caches apps rebuild, crash reports, the trash and forgotten downloads. You choose what goes.

cleanup.left.one: 1 file was in use and was left.
cleanup.left.other: {n} files were in use and were left.

cleanup.looking: Looking for files to clean up
cleanup.nothing_here_can_go: There are no temporary files, caches or old downloads to clean up.
cleanup.see_what_takes_the_most_room: See which folders and files take the most room
cleanup.trashed: {size} went to the trash; empty it to free that too.
drives.a_backup_folder_made_by_finder: A backup folder made by Finder or iTunes
drives.also_reads_every_sector_finds_los: Also reads every sector: finds lost partitions, formatted drives and files by their signature.
drives.choose_an_iphone_or_ipad_backup: Choose an iPhone or iPad backup
drives.connect_the_drive_you_want_to: Connect the drive you want to recover from, then refresh. On a phone, connect a USB drive or memory card through an OTG adapter.
drives.datadoc_reads_the_drive_without_c: DataDoc reads the drive without changing it. Save what you recover onto a different drive, so nothing overwrites the files still waiting to be found.
drives.only_what_was_deleted_from_it: Only what was deleted from it
drives.partitions_note: Scan one partition, such as C:, or only one folder on it. It's quicker, since only its file system is read; files found by signature need the whole drive scanned.
drives.reading_drives_directly_needs_adm: Reading drives directly needs administrator rights. DataDoc only reads; it never writes to the drive you scan.
drives.reads_the_file_systems_for_delete: Reads the file systems for deleted files. Takes seconds to minutes.
dupes.also_find_similar_photos_and_video: Also find similar photos and videos
dupes.also_lightly_edited_copies_and_bur: Also lightly edited copies and burst shots that barely differ.
dupes.also_photos_of_the_same_scene: Also photos of the same scene taken moments apart. Check before removing.
dupes.choose_one_or_more_folders_below: Choose one or more folders below.
dupes.delete_message: This frees {size}. One copy of each group stays; this phone has no trash to put the others back from.
dupes.every_file_in_these_folders_is: Every file in these folders is one of a kind.
dupes.finds_files_that_are_exact_copies: Finds files that are exact copies, photos saved again at another size or quality, and the same video exported twice. You choose what goes; one copy of each always stays.
dupes.only_the_same_picture_resized_or: Only the same picture, resized or saved again.
dupes.photos_jpeg_png_gif_webp_bmp: Photos: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP and TIFF. Videos: MP4 and MOV.
dupes.trash_message: This frees {size}. One copy of each group stays where it is, and you can put the others back from the trash.
errors.that_file_can_t_be_read: that file can't be read in place; copy the image to this device's storage and open it from there

folderchooser.there_s_no_folder_at_that: There's no folder at that path
label.Looking for deleted messages and r: Looking for deleted messages and records
platform.files_are_saved_in_downloads_da: Files are saved in Downloads/DataDoc on this phone's storage, apart from the drive being recovered.
platform.files_are_saved_in_the_files: Files are saved in the Files app, under On My iPhone › DataDoc › Recovered.
preview.select_a_file_to_preview_it: Select a file to preview it
recover.choose_a_folder_to_save_the: choose a folder to save the files in
recover.that_folder_is_on_the_drive: that folder is on the drive being recovered; writing there could overwrite the files. Choose a folder on another drive
recover.the_drive_disconnected_plug_it_b: the drive disconnected. Plug it back in and recover again; what the scan found is kept
recoverdialog.failed: {files} couldn't be read; the recovery report lists them and why.
recoverdialog.files_marked_fair_or_poor_: Files marked fair or poor may be partly overwritten. Open a few to check them before relying on them.
recoverdialog.keep_the_folders_the_files: Keep the folders the files were in
recoverdialog.recovering_from_a_disk_ima: Recovering from a disk image only reads it; the image is never changed.
recoverdialog.this_folder_is_on_another_: This folder is on another drive, so recovering can't overwrite anything still on the scanned one.
recoverdialog.title: Recover {files}
recoverdialog.where_should_the_recovered: Where should the recovered files go?
rename.name: Name
rename.number_photos_put_the_date_they: Number photos, put the date they were taken in their names, find and replace words, change case. Every new name is shown before anything changes, clashes are caught, and the last rename can be undone.
rename.this_folder_has_no_files_to: This folder has no files to rename.
results.check_the_files_and_folders_to: Check the files and folders to recover
results.every_sector_was_read_but_nothin: Every sector was read, but nothing recognizable is left. The drive may be encrypted (BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS), wiped, or an SSD that has trimmed its free space.
results.matches: {matches} in this folder and the folders inside it
results.no_file_system_could_be_read: No file system could be read
results.nothing_here_matches_the_search_: Nothing here matches the search and filters.
results.the_drive_may_have_been_formatte: The drive may have been formatted or its partitions lost. A deep scan reads every sector, finds lost partitions and recognizes files by their signature.
results.this_folder_has_no_deleted_files: This folder has no deleted files. Switch to All files to see everything in it.
scan.folder_not_on_a_drive: That folder isn't on a drive DataDoc can read directly, such as a network or cloud folder.
space.click_a_tile_or_a_row: Click a tile or a row to select it; click it again to open a folder.
space.delete_message: {name}, the {what}, is deleted, freeing {size}. This phone has no trash to put it back from.
space.measure_a_drive_or_folder_to: Measure a drive or folder to see every folder's size as a map: the larger the tile, the more space it takes. Open folders to look deeper, and move what you don't need to the trash.
space.some_of_this_folder_couldn_t: Some of this folder couldn't be read, so its size counts only what could.
space.trash_message: {name}, the {what}, goes to the trash, freeing {size}. You can put it back from there.
